integrity: Proof is analytic and self-reviewed; numerical comparisons are finite corroboration, no independent audit or verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The dyadic cyclic exact-four-spike theorem does not classify all second-level extremizers, imply robust noise stability, or extend to noncyclic and odd-order groups; historical priority is qualified by inaccessible primary full texts.
title: Sharp second-support gap for four-sparse Fourier transforms on dyadic cycles
